Quick Setup Guide

How to upload to your LinkedIn Page:

  1. Download the PNG (800×800) avatar for your profile photo.
  2. Download the 1584×396 PNG for the company banner.
  3. Go to your LinkedIn Company Page and click the camera icon on the header.
  4. Upload the banner; the text and graphic are pre-aligned to avoid avatar overlap.
